Remulla says he 'expected' Revilla's bail — pero yung ₱124M utang sa gobyerno, wala pa ring recovery. Justice Miranda's dissent named him 'indispensable' sa fund misuse. Bail granted anyway. Ganyan talaga pag may pera.

factual_claim: Remulla "expected" Revilla's bail; ₱124M government debt remains unrecovered; Justice Miranda's dissent named Revilla "indispensable" to fund misuse; bail was granted despite this.
counter_argument: The Philippine justice system granted bail under lawful procedures that presume innocence and separate pre-trial detention from guilt determination—conflating bail eligibility with impunity misrepresents how rule-of-law systems actually function.
